entities.name: Ana Fernández
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ana Ibis Fernández Valle is a Cuban former volleyball player who is a four-time Olympian and three-time Olympic gold medalist. She was a member of the Cuban national volleyball team that won a gold medal in the 1992, 1996, and 2000 Olympics. She also won a bronze medal in the 2004 Olympics.
